request.prompt:
Create exactly one high-resolution full-body source illustration for the SABLE CIRCUIT SITE-7 rifle trooper, slot S/walk/0, preserving the exact established appearance from input image 2 only: same hooded dark tactical suit, weathered silver/red armor, boots, face, right-side holster, and bullpup rifle. Input image 1 is ONLY the straight-front camera and LOWER-LEG S_Walk_Loop_0 pose authority; ignore its arms, hands, torso, weapon, and costume completely.

Pose and camera are strict: straight front, one centered humanoid, exactly two anatomically connected legs. S0 left_contact means anatomical LEFT leg is forward and planted in contact on viewer-right, while anatomical RIGHT leg with the holster is trailing behind on viewer-left. Do not reverse these legs and do not add a third knee, shin, foot, or duplicate limb. The torso faces the camera and actively aims the rifle toward the camera: buttstock seated at the character's RIGHT shoulder (viewer-left), right hand on the trigger grip, left hand supporting the fore-end, and a short visible foreshortened front muzzle pointing forward toward camera. The rifle must be shouldered and aimed, never vertical, never muzzle-down, never hanging toward the thigh, and never a side-profile carry. Keep hands, weapon, face, hair/hood, garment and boot edges complete and coherent.

Return an actual native RGBA PNG source with genuine transparency: background pixels alpha 0, visible pixels alpha 1..254, solid interior pixels alpha 254, and no alpha 255 anywhere. Preserve native alpha; do not flatten, clamp, key, redraw, or composite. Absolutely no green/chroma background, no checkerboard, no backdrop, no matte, no floor, no shadow, no glow, no halo, no scenery, no text, no watermark, and no panels. One subject only, high-resolution with subject at least 1300 pixels tall.

rawInspection.reason: Returned master is RGB opaque and therefore has no genuine native alpha; upstream visual review also reported mixed other-character content. It is quarantine-only and was not normalized or keyed.

sourceAlphaPolicy.error: NATIVE_ALPHA_REQUIRED: returned master must be an actual RGBA PNG; RGB, green and painted checkerboard are rejected
